author: a. n. kent
title: North Florida volleyball announces 2026 spring schedule with four matches - Duval Times
text:
North Florida Volleyball announced its 2026 spring schedule on March 25, outlining four matches against teams from four different Division I conferences.
The announcement is significant as it highlights the team’s upcoming competition against strong opponents, including two schools from Power Four conferences. This provides North Florida an opportunity to test itself against programs that had winning records in the previous season.
According to the schedule, North Florida will play one home match, one neutral-site match, and two road matches during the spring. The team will open its campaign with a closed match at UCF in Orlando on March 28. In April, North Florida will participate in a doubleheader at Georgia Southern and face College of Charleston on April 11 at Hanner Fieldhouse in Statesboro, Georgia.
The final game of the spring slate is scheduled for April 17 at UNF Arena against Florida State. Doors for this home event will open to the public at 4:30 p.m., with play beginning at 5 p.m.
All four of North Florida’s spring opponents finished their previous seasons with winning records. The schedule includes opportunities for fans to attend select matches and watch North Florida compete against established programs.
